overview.processingCredit: Processing level is NouriSearch's own rule-based classification.
recipe.surveyNote: This is a USDA survey recipe, a composite used to estimate what people eat. It is not an authentic recipe for this dish.
related.none: Nothing related has been found yet.
ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.none: USDA lists no ingredient breakdown for this food, so nothing can be traced to an ingredient.
ingredients.lastOne: A dish needs at least one ingredient.
ingredients.noQuantity: A source of {nutrient}, amount not stated
ingredients.contributesNothing: Supplies 5% or more of no nutrient with known data.
modified.title: Modified version
modified.count: {count} changed. Values are recalculated from USDA's recipe.
modified.failed: That change could not be calculated, so the dish is back to how it was.
profile.title: Your nutrient profile
profile.unavailable: Saving foods to your profile is not available yet.
profile.pageBody: Your nutrient profile is not available yet. It will use foods you choose or mark as eaten, not your searches.
nutrients.title: Nutrients
nutrients.noServing: USDA lists no household serving, so values are per 100 g.
nutrients.scale: Bars show percent of the Daily Value in this serving. The tick marks {threshold}%, which the FDA treats as high.
nutrients.keyNote: Bold names and gold bars mark the key nutrients: those the FDA's guide singles out, plus protein, energy, and total sugars. A red bar marks a high serving.
nutrients.compareNote: Age and sex groups use the National Academies' daily amounts, which are set for people without medical conditions. They do not cover infants, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Your choice stays in this browser.
nutrients.scalePersonal: Bars compare this serving with the daily amounts for {group}. High marks still follow the FDA's Daily Values, so the {threshold}% tick appears only where the two match.
nutrients.referenceFailed: The daily amounts for this group could not load, so this page is showing FDA Daily Values.
mark.question: Unknown
detail.estimated: Borrowed from a similar food, so this is an estimate.
detail.approximate: This recipe does not fully explain USDA's published value, so the change is approximate.
detail.lowerBound: The true value is at least this much, because some ingredients have no data.
detail.unknownValue: No source gives a value for this nutrient in this food.
detail.zeroReported: USDA reports zero here without saying whether it was measured or assumed.
detail.zeroAssumed: USDA assumes zero here, because the nutrient is insignificant or does not occur naturally in this food.
detail.totalSugarsNote: The FDA sets a Daily Value for added sugars, not for total sugars, so these grams have no Daily Value to compare with.
detail.addedSugarsNote: USDA's data has no added-sugar values, so this stays unknown unless a food label states one. The Daily Value is {dailyValue} g.
detail.noDailyValue: The FDA sets no Daily Value for this nutrient.
detail.reference.rda: Compared with {amount} a day, the Recommended Dietary Allowance for {group}.
detail.reference.ai: Compared with {amount} a day, the Adequate Intake for {group}. An Adequate Intake is set where the evidence cannot support a firmer number.
detail.reference.cdrr: Compared with {amount} a day, the level above which the National Academies advise lowering intake for {group}.
detail.reference.general: No amount exists for {group}, so this compares with the FDA's {amount} a day.
detail.proteinNote: This amount assumes a reference body weight, at 0.8 g per kg for adults, so a person's own need can differ.
detail.energyNote: 2,000 calories a day is the FDA's general guide. Calorie needs may be higher or lower, and vary with age, sex, height, weight, and physical activity.
conclusion.high_percent_daily_value: This serving ({serving}) has {percent} of the Daily Value. The FDA treats {threshold}% or more as high.
conclusion.high_percent_daily_value.lowe: This serving ({serving}) has at least {percent} of the Daily Value, which is already above the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
conclusion.not_high_percent_daily_value: This serving ({serving}) has {percent} of the Daily Value, below the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.no_value: We cannot tell whether this serving ({serving}) is high, because the amount is unknown.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.no_daily_v: We cannot tell whether this serving ({serving}) is high, because no Daily Value applies.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.lower_boun: This serving ({serving}) has at least {percent} of the Daily Value. Some ingredients have no data, so it could still reach the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
sources.title: Sources
footer.disclaimer: NouriSearch is educational. It does not diagnose nutritional deficiencies or give medical advice.
substitution.none: Nothing we know of moves {nutrient} in this dish by a noticeable amount.
substitution.noneClose: We have no close replacement for this ingredient yet.
substitution.unavailable.no_weight: USDA states no amount for this ingredient, so a change cannot be calculated.
substitution.unavailable.goal_unknown: USDA gives no {nutrient} value for this dish, so a change cannot be judged.
substitution.effectApproximate: {nutrient} per {serving}: {before} to about {after}. Approximate, because USDA's recipe does not fully explain its value.
substitution.origin.curated: A swap on our reviewed list.
substitution.origin.same_role: The same kind of ingredient. Nobody has reviewed this swap.
substitution.origin.use_less: The same ingredient, less of it.
substitution.origin.use_more: The same ingredient, more of it.
substitution.score.title: How this ranked
substitution.couldNotEvaluate: USDA has no value to compare for: {names}.
allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.noneFound: We found none of the nine major allergens in USDA's name or recipe for this food. That does not mean it has none.
allergens.disclaimer: USDA lists no allergens. We read them from food names and recipes, and we can miss some. A product's label is the only reliable source.
allergens.avoidedHas: You avoid {allergen}, and this dish has it.
allergens.avoidedMay: You avoid {allergen}, and this dish may have it.
allergens.storedHere: Your choices stay in this browser.
diet.label: Diet
add.recipeWeight: The whole recipe weighs {grams} g, so a small amount may barely change a serving.
